topic: 预处理与采集数据质量
title: 真实Zabbix依赖链停采：只恢复被禁用主项，原子项同ID继续收样
answer:
```python
def resume_master(master):
 if master.get('itemid')!='1000001' or master.get('key_')!='master.payload' or str(master.get('type'))!='2' or str(master.get('value_type'))!='4' or str(master.get('status')) not in ('0','1') or str(master.get('templateid','0'))!='0' or str(master.get('flags','0'))!='0':raise ValueError('approved owned text trapper master required')
 return {'itemid':master['itemid'],'status':0}
```

原题知识说明：
它们失去新输入，数据更新和触发器行为会受影响。变更前检查依赖树及告警，迁移时先提供有效新master而非仅改显示名称。

conversion.original_title: 删除或禁用master item会对dependent items有什么影响？

body:
## 操作任务
实现resume_master(master)，只批准独立itemid1000001/key_=master.payload、type2/Text value_type4、status0或1。返回仅itemid/status0的最小恢复计划；继承、发现或其他对象拒绝，原输入不变。真实服务端先由主项驱动两个dependent入库，再仅禁用主项，验证主项不能收样而仍启用的子项没有新值；应用你的计划后，原两个子项以相同itemid及预处理恢复收样，旧历史和其他主项不变。不能把子项仍为enabled解释为数据源正常。只验证禁用再启用；不删除master、不声称能恢复已删除对象或丢失历史。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32和私有PostgreSQL15.19，实际trapper ACK、缓存重载、Text master与dependent历史；仅私有判分器应用批准字段，非生产变更或PHP JSON-RPC API，不构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,os,pathlib,time,copy,json,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def reload_complete(server):
 offset=server.log.stat().st_size;result=subprocess.run(['zabbix_server','-c',str(server.config),'-R','config_cache_reload'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3);assert result.returncode==0
 server.wait(lambda:'finished forced reloading of the configuration cache' in server.log.read_text()[offset:],'current configuration cache reload completed')
with PrivateServer() as server:
 db=server.db
 db.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','Private training node',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends) VALUES(1000001,1000000,2,'Master','master.payload',4,'1d','0'),(1000011,1000000,2,'Protected master','protected.payload',4,'1d','0'); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,master_itemid,history,trends) VALUES(1000002,1000000,18,'RX dependent','derived.rx',0,1000001,'1d','0'),(1000003,1000000,18,'TX dependent','derived.tx',0,1000001,'1d','0'); INSERT INTO item_preproc(item_preprocid,itemid,step,type,params) VALUES(10000020,1000002,1,12,'$.rx'),(10000030,1000003,1,12,'$.tx'); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000001),(1000002),(1000003),(1000011)")
 server.start()
 def sampled(rx,tx):
  payload=json.dumps(dict(rx=rx,tx=tx));stamp,ack=server.send(payload,key='master.payload');assert 'processed: 1; failed: 0;' in ack['info'],ack
  for itemid,value in ((1000002,rx),(1000003,tx)):
   server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from history where itemid='+str(itemid)+' and clock='+str(stamp//1000000000)+' and ns='+str(stamp%1000000000))==[[str(value)]],'dependent receives new value at master timestamp')
  assert db.execute('select value from history_text where itemid=1000001 and clock='+str(stamp//1000000000)+' and ns='+str(stamp%1000000000))==[[payload]]
  return stamp
 old=sampled(7,9);history=db.execute('select itemid,clock,ns,value from history where itemid in(1000002,1000003) order by itemid,clock,ns')
 metadata=db.execute('select itemid,key_,type,value_type,master_itemid,history,trends,status from items where itemid in(1000002,1000003,1000011) order by itemid')
 mastermeta=db.execute('select key_,type,value_type,history,trends from items where itemid=1000001')
 db.execute('UPDATE items SET status=1 WHERE itemid=1000001');reload_complete(server)
 stamp,ack=server.send('{"rx":100,"tx":200}',key='master.payload');assert 'processed: 0; failed: 1;' in ack['info'];time.sleep(.5)
 assert history==db.execute('select itemid,clock,ns,value from history where itemid in(1000002,1000003) order by itemid,clock,ns')
 assert metadata==db.execute('select itemid,key_,type,value_type,master_itemid,history,trends,status from items where itemid in(1000002,1000003,1000011) order by itemid')
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_DISABLED_MASTER_REJECTS_INPUT_ENABLED_DEPENDENTS_RETAIN_ONLY_OLD_HISTORY',flush=True)
 master=dict(itemid='1000001',key_='master.payload',type='2',value_type='4',status='1',templateid='0',flags='0');before=copy.deepcopy(master)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:resume_master_same_dependency_ids',flush=True)
 patch=task.resume_master(master);assert master==before and patch.keys()=={'itemid','status'} and patch['itemid']=='1000001' and type(patch['status']) is int and patch['status'] in (0,1)
 db.execute('UPDATE items SET status='+str(patch['status'])+' WHERE itemid=1000001');reload_complete(server);sampled(12,15)
 assert db.execute('select value from history where itemid=1000002 order by clock,ns')==[['7'],['12']] and db.execute('select value from history where itemid=1000003 order by clock,ns')==[['9'],['15']]
 assert metadata==db.execute('select itemid,key_,type,value_type,master_itemid,history,trends,status from items where itemid in(1000002,1000003,1000011) order by itemid')
 assert mastermeta==db.execute('select key_,type,value_type,history,trends from items where itemid=1000001')
 assert task.resume_master({**master,'status':'0'})==patch
 for field,value in (('itemid','1000011'),('key_','wrong'),('type','18'),('value_type','0'),('status','3'),('templateid','9'),('flags','4')):
  try:task.resume_master({**master,field:value})
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('unapproved master accepted')
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_MASTER_RESUME_SAME_DEPENDENT_IDS_AND_PREPROCESSING_OLD_HISTORY_PLUS_NEW_TIMESTAMPED_VALUES',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
